invariants.rationale: The method always initializes and returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata instance.
The method assumes inputRecords is not null to process records.
The table is used for timeline and instant management; it is required to be non-null.
config is used for configuration checks such as shouldAllowMultiWriteOnSameInstant; cannot be null.
executor is cast and used for updating index/pre-commit; must not be null at exit.
